And if I change my mind, how easy is it to return?

Digital Assistant · AI says:

We understand plans can change, so we try to make returns straightforward.

Online orders (NZ & AU): Change-of-mind returns accepted within 30 days of delivery. NZ orders include a free prepaid courier label; AU orders are returned by post. Items must be unworn, unwashed, with tags attached.
In-store purchases (including Endless Aisle): Change-of-mind returns accepted within 14 days for a refund, and up to 30 days for exchange or store credit, with proof of purchase. Items must be in original condition with tags.
Where to return: Online NZ orders can go back to our returns center using the label or to any Barkers store. Australian online orders return to our Australian returns address. In-store and Endless Aisle purchases must be taken back to a Barkers store.

As long as items meet the condition and timeframe requirements, returning your order is designed to be quick and simple.
